phase: B4 data-window research, level-1 supplemental measurements
registered_at_source: written before any ladder process started
purpose: Fill an idle cloud window with level-1 measurements that sharpen the registered data-amount question, without escalating to level 2, without promoting anything and without reading the sealed interval.
question: Within the registered 132-day window, where does the out-of-sample RankIC peak sit on the training-amount axis, and does the peak move when the window holds 132 instead of 60 days?

relation_to_registered_probe.note: the C1/C2/C3 verdict and the escalation decision belong to that document; this supplement neither re-reads it nor may overturn it
relation_to_registered_probe.level_2_status: still requires its own pre-registration and is still not authorized by anything here

components.role: training-amount curve at the registered 132-day window, on seeds that the registered probe does not use
same-environment 60-day control curve; the registered control is not re-run and is not replaced
extra support seeds for the C1 interval; descriptive, never a replacement for the registered three seeds

declared_reading.peak_rule: for each seed, the peak point is the argmax of out-of-sample RankIC over the declared points; the component-level peak is the mode of the three seed peaks and is reported together with all three values, never as a single number
declared_reading.right_shift_rule: declare 'the optimum moved right with more data' only when the 132-day component peak sits at a point larger than the 60-day component peak for at least two of three seeds, and the seed-mean RankIC at that larger point exceeds the seed-mean RankIC at 1.32 by at least 0.0017 - the same magnitude as the registered minimum meaningful improvement, borrowed and not re-derived
declared_reading.cross_environment_rule: component B is a machine and torch-build robustness check against the recorded 60-day values; if any point of seed 11 shifts by more than 0.0020 the cross-environment comparability of the registered control is reported as impaired and the C1 reading is flagged, not silently kept
declared_reading.support_seed_rule: component C widens the C1 interval for reporting only; the registered three seeds remain the registered evidence and a six-seed interval may not be presented as the registered result

prohibitions: no escalation, no level 2, no promotion, no replacement of the incumbent
no reading of the sealed interval
no change to any promotion threshold, secondary line, net5 limit, cost scenario or period count
no reporting of a single seed as a candidate
no re-selection of a component, seed or point after its value has been read
no C1 verdict from this document, in either direction
no relaxation of the exposure reconciliation, the coverage floor or the resume fail-closed rule
queue_rules: a component may start only when a free process slot exists and the memory pre-flight allows it
each plan is one process and one uninterrupted trajectory; a plan is never split
a failed process is retried at most once, then skipped and reported; the queue continues
the whole queue is drained in priority order and stops when the window closes
partial completion is reported as partial: a component with fewer than three finished seeds is described as incomplete
open_items_after_registration: the real peak location is read from the replay of exported weights, not from the cloud validation score
